settings.title: Settings
profile.password.title: Change password
profile.password.done: Password changed, the other sessions ended
profile.password.tooShort: The password is shorter than 12 characters
profile.2fa.title: Two-factor authentication
recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: Each code works once and replaces the code from the app if the phone is lost.
recovery.low: only a few are left, generate new ones
recovery.regenerateHint: The old codes stop working. Enter your password to confirm.
recovery.shown: Save the codes now: they are not shown again.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: Sign in with one button on the sign-in page, no login and no password. The key is stored on the device, in a password manager or in the keychain.
passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys need HTTPS (or localhost) with a domain name and a browser with WebAuthn support. If the address of the panel changes, the keys must be added again.
passkeys.name: Name (for example, MacBook)
users.title: Users
users.hint: An administrator has full access. An operator works only on the chosen servers and with the chosen modules, an auditor only looks at the dashboard, the overview and the metrics of the chosen servers. Every action is written to the audit log.
users.confirmPassword: All sessions of the user end.
users.confirmDelete: Delete the user {login}? Their sessions end and their dashboard is removed.
users.confirmReset2fa: Reset the 2FA, recovery codes and passkeys of {login}? Their sessions end.
users.passwordSet: Password changed, the sessions of the user ended
snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.hint: Terminal commands shared by all users. In the terminal the Snippets list can paste and run a command at once or only paste it.
snippets.name: Name
term.snippetsEmpty: No snippets. Add them in Settings.
docker.update.title: Update the container {name}
docker.update.text: The image is pulled again and the container is recreated with the same settings. It stops for a moment; if the new one does not start, the old one is brought back.
docker.update.compose: The container was created by docker compose: the service of the project is updated with docker compose pull and up -d.
users.roleHint.admin: Full access to everything: servers, users, the settings of the panel.
users.roleHint.operator: Works on the chosen servers and only with the chosen modules. Does not change the settings of the panel, add or delete agents, or reboot servers.
users.roleHint.auditor: Only looks at the dashboard, the overview and the metrics of the chosen servers. Changes nothing.
acc.servers.title: Available servers
acc.servers.hint: The switch of a group gives access to all its servers, also to those that join it later. The servers of the group are then on by themselves and cannot be picked one by one.
acc.modules.title: Available modules
acc.modules.hint: The dashboard, the overview and the metrics are always available. The other tabs open only for the chosen modules, on every server the user may see.
acc.modules.rootWarn: The modules marked "root access" let a user do almost anything on the host: for example, an operator with the terminal can delete the agent or add their own key. Give them only to those you trust like an administrator.
acc.mod.terminal: A root shell on the server and snippets.
acc.mod.assistant: The screen and the control of a computer in the browser: the Windows console and RDP sessions, the Linux desktop; the picture settings.
acc.mod.desktop: The screen of a Windows computer in the browser (remote desktop).
acc.mod.files: View and edit any file, upload and download.
acc.mod.disk: Partitions, what takes the space, cleanup.
acc.mod.firewall: nftables rules and the journal of matches.
acc.mod.users: Local accounts of the server: create, rights, delete, a terminal as the user.
dash.group.hint: Groups collect servers on the dashboard: the group filter and the access of operators. The order here is the order in the dashboard list.
